bias.detail: masks recomputed on a panel truncated by 120 sessions are bit-identical over 1067 shared sessions (14 masks)

the PRIMARY configuration (thr=3%, First(10), V5 band, MApresent union) is not a point of the pre-registered 450-cell grid and was fixed in the SPEC before any result; its net30 sits at grid percentile 0.122

the Tushare cache carries no point-in-time delisting flag (delist_status=DELIST_PIT_UNAVAILABLE); the universe is ST- and name-based only.  Stocks whose last print falls >60 sessions before the panel end are reported, not silently dropped
bias.value: n_codes_gone=242, of which 183 carry a PRIMARY-arm event

bias.detail: entry = close[t], exit = close[t+1]; no T-day intraday price is ever used as a fill (open[t], low[t], high[t], vwap[t] are unused).  The stored leg is float32, so the comparison is made on the float32 grid and the tolerance is one float32 ulp
same-stock signal clustering inside 20 sessions; N is NOT treated as the independent sample size
the "first" window is BACKWARD-looking only ([t-10, t-1]); the deliberately forward-looking variant produces a different event count, which proves the backward rule is the one in use
the SPEC was written and hashed before this run started (its mtime precedes the run log), the run re-verifies the SPEC hash at start-up, and the primary configuration is not the grid argmax
matched resampling: the only forbidden cell is the event itself; each replicate draws once per event; the null spread is finite and non-degenerate

prereg.title: First >=3% bullish mid-bar at the close -> next-close exit
prereg.body_rule: (close - open) / open    [task text; NOT hve_common px.body]
prereg.first_rule: First_w = E0 & ~any_prev(E0, w); window [t-w, t-1], today excluded
prereg.vr_note: VR20 = vol[t] / mean(vol[t-20 .. t-1]); denominator EXCLUDES t; suspended sessions are NaN, not zero
